messages:
sam: FYI planning a regional SLO rebaseline + fallback dry-run next Wed 01:30-03:30 UTC. Purpose: validate new p99 targets and fallback routing under simulated spike. No customer-visible weight changes unless we hit hard rollback.

anita: Outline?

sam: Short: 01:10 preflight checks, 01:30 start synthetic spike (tagged enterprise), 01:40 enable fallback policy in test mode, 02:00 life-checks and autoscale observation, 02:30 controlled increase, 03:00 cooldown, 03:30 postmortem. Rollback triggers: p99 > 300ms for 5m OR error rate > 1% 3m. Soft trigger: p99 > 240ms 3m => engage fallback.

rui: Proxy snippet for fallback flag:
```
if header(x-tenant-tier)=="enterprise" and flag(fallback-test)==true -> route pref: reserved(0.7), shared(0.3)
```
I'll prepare the flag and push to canary proxies.

slo-bot: SLO note: rebaseline draft posted: https://intranet.redwood/slo/drafts/regional-rebaseline. Effective date TBD.

anita: Observability checklist added to runbook: synthetic probes from 3 regions, trace sample 100% for 20m, metric namespace suffix ".dryrun". Alerts scoped to .dryrun only.

sam: Loadtest cmd for teams:
`./tools/loadtest --tag slo-dryrun --qps 500 --duration 20m --header "x-tenant-tier: enterprise"`

deploy-bot: Maintenance scheduled: slo-rebaseline-dryrun by sam on 2410056789 (Wed 01:30-03:30 UTC). Notified groups: eng-sre, eng-runtime, product.

rui: ack, will post PR for flag and proxy rollout.

anita: I'll own observability during the window. Short updates only in this thread. :white_check_mark:
